page.overview:
Who is Arnolone Syndrome Devil?

The の|Ānoron Shōkōgun no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of Arnolone syndrome.

The Arnolone Syndrome Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Arnolone Syndrome Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point, prior to the events of Chainsaw Man, the Arnolone Syndrome Devil was eaten by Pochita, thus ridding its existence along with the existence of Arnolone syndrome from the world.
